summary: One bulletin (issue Sept 6, 2026). It prints no Mass schedule box: the only Mass times are the one-week calendar on p4 (Sunday 9 am Mass; Friday Sept 11 10 am anniversary Mass). The website lists 'Sunday 9:00am' as the Mass Schedule. One open question: whether the Sunday 9:00 AM Mass is weekly (POLICY would call the bulletin's single dated listing dated). Confession is by appointment only.

sources.said: Weekly Calendar - September 6, 2026 - September 12, 2026: Sunday September 6 - 9 am Mass
Mass Intentions: Sunday - September 6 Richard Lyons; Sunday - September 13 RoseAnn Asmus (no times)
Mass Schedule Sunday 9:00am 109 Grand St. Altamont, NY 12009

slots.rationale: The newest (only) bulletin prints the 9 am Mass only under one date in a one-week calendar, which POLICY (Weekly or dated, rule 3) sorts as dated, and rule 4 needs two weeks. The Mass intentions list a second Sunday (Sept 13) without a time. The website's Mass Schedule says Sunday 9:00am, and extract history also stored it weekly. Leaning weekly because the website gives it as the regular schedule (R6: the website backs up a reading but can't outweigh the bulletin, so asked). A dated Sept 6 entry would be before as_of and out of scope (R16), so the alternative is leaving it out.
slots.question: Is the Sunday 9:00 AM Mass at St. Lucy/St. Bernadette weekly?

slots.rationale: R16: a dated Mass on September 11, before as_of (2026-09-28), so it is out of scope. It is also a special occasion Mass (the 25th anniversary), not part of the regular schedule. Recorded so history's event for it is matched (R9).
